items.title: File Widerspruch against reduced dental subsidy
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit dieser Entscheidung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch bei der Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The Widerspruchsfrist is one month (§ 84 SGG) starting from Bekanntgabe (notification) of the decision. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a letter sent by ordinary post within Germany is deemed delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the third day after it was put in the mail (dispatch date), unless a weekend/holiday pushes it forward to the next business day, or unless actual delivery was proven to be later/earlier. This letter carries no printed document date anywhere, so neither the dispatch date nor the start of the Bekanntgabe period can be established. Without a start date, the one-month deadline (which would otherwise run per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB to the corresponding day of the following month, shifted to the next business day under § 193 BGB if it fell on a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday) cannot be computed. The person must check the actual letter/envelope for a postmark or issue date and count one month from (postmark date + 3 days), adjusted for weekends/holidays.

warnings: The letter has no visible document date (Ausstellungsdatum) anywhere in the letterhead or body, so the start of the one-month Widerspruchsfrist (Bekanntgabe, § 37 SGB X) cannot be computed; check the envelope's postmark or any dated cover note and count one month from three days after that date, adjusted for weekends/NRW holidays under § 193 BGB.

No amount is stated for the rejected doubled Festzuschuss (only the approved single Festzuschuss of 1.104,00 € is given), so it is unclear how much more the person would have received if the Widerspruch succeeded.
